notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.6.5: clearer at a glance

• AI Factory: "Continue where you left off" puts what needs you first (a decision, a review, a blocker), then what's running, with a one-line summary. Work options sit behind Options, right under the request box, and your choices are kept. When no agent is ready, the button is the setup step itself.
• Inbox: one column, in the order to answer things. Updates fold away. An approval shows exactly what it allows before you can allow it, and Deny is always there. A request that must be answered can't be dismissed instead.
• Board and Work: grouped by what each item needs (Needs attention, In progress, Ready for review, Not started, Done), with incidents marked.
• Work Item: Overview, Preview and Evidence. The status line says when activity was last confirmed and how far the evidence covers the current revision. Ready-for-review work offers Open preview, View evidence and Request changes. The Coordinator folds away and keeps your draft.
• Evidence: a Verification Summary with the verdict, criteria and checks that add up, visual captures, risks and gaps, and whether the evidence is current. A blocked criterion is never shown as verified. Approval stays yours.
• Fixed: the Factory side panel called review-ready work "Verified" even when it wasn't.
